title: Speech-DRAME: A Framework for Human-Aligned Benchmarks in Speech Role-Play
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking spoken role-play capabilities of models, specifically assessing linguistic and paralinguistic features such as prosody, emotion, and character consistency. While it includes an ethics statement regarding data collection and mentions cultural stereotypes in the context of role archetypes, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
